name: Acuity
fiscalYearEnd: August 31 (FY2025 ended Aug 31, 2025; Q3 FY2026 ended May 31, 2026; FY2026 10-K due about late October 2026)
description: Acuity makes commercial and industrial light fixtures (Lithonia Lighting, Holophane, Juno, Peerless and others) plus lighting controls, and since January 2025 a fast-growing building-technology business: Distech building-management controls, the Atrius data platform, and QSC audio-video-control (Q-SYS), bought for $1.2B. Lighting (ABL) is 83% of sales and 89% of segment profit; it sells mostly through independent sales agencies and electrical distributors to contractors on new construction, renovation and retrofit, with about 100 sourcing sites, 57 of them in Mexico. The Intelligent Spaces segment (AIS) tripled in sales because of QSC but earns lower margins (10.0% vs 16.4% for lighting), and the acquisition added debt and intangible amortization. Lighting margin depends on tariffs, freight and commodity costs (electronics and steel) as much as on volume.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not re-checked against MSCI/S&P. SEC SIC 3640 (Electric Lighting & Wiring Equipment).

hq.note: 1170 Peachtree Street N.E., Suite 1200, Atlanta, GA 30309 (FY2025 10-K cover); Delaware corporation

employees.note: About 13,800: about 4,300 US, 8,200 Mexico, remainder other international (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Acuity Brands Lighting and Lighting Controls (ABL)
businessLines.how: Sells fixtures and controls to electrical distributors and via independent sales agencies and direct reps; one-time product sales tied to construction, renovation and retrofit activity, with price and product mix (LED and controls content) driving margin.
businessLines.description: Luminaires, drivers, controls (nLight, SensorSwitch) and wiring solutions for commercial, industrial and infrastructure buildings; brands include Lithonia Lighting, Holophane, Juno, Peerless, Gotham, Mark Architectural, American Electric Lighting and others.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating profit as reported (before corporate costs of about $102.8M, derived as the difference to consolidated operating profit of $563.9M); share computed against the $666.7M sum of the two segments

businessLines.name: Acuity Intelligent Spaces (AIS)
businessLines.how: Sells building-control hardware, embedded software and cloud subscriptions through integrators and distributors; QSC adds professional audio-video system sales and recurring software.
businessLines.description: Distech Controls building-management systems, Atrius spatial-intelligence data platform, and QSC (Q-SYS audio, video and control platform), acquired Jan 1, 2025.

operatingProfit.note: segment operating profit as reported (before corporate costs of about $102.8M, derived as the difference to consolidated operating profit of $563.9M); share computed against the $666.7M sum of the two segments
